verdict.rationale: Signifyd exposes webhooks that fire on fraud/guarantee decisions and mentions a 'Decision Center' where 'policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint' — evidence of event-triggered automation and rule configuration, but no documentation of a general-purpose rules engine, conditions/actions syntax, or how an AI-native user would programmatically define such rules beyond the built-in policy UI. Missing for 10: detailed rules-definition API/schema, examples of custom action chains, and any AI-agent-specific tooling for rule creation.
